name: Hinata
source:
A shy and timid girl, her classmates refer to her as the "Mermaid Princess". She's been in love with Kotarou for a long time, but is unable to confess her feelings due to a lack of confidence. She's the ace of the swimming club, and is skilled enough to likely be able to win a prefectural tournament if she were to try. 

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2020/03/03/tm/]Official Website[/url]]
